intro.text: Dalinar's father, an Alethi brightlord who died before the War of Reckoning.

items.text: His branch of House Kholin was one of the poorer ones, unable to afford monasteries or practice guards, and he did not live in Kholinar. He fought in a war in his youth, and when Dalinar was old enough to learn the sword, he hired Harth, a swordsman from two towns over, to teach him.

He fought many duels over honour and gave them more time than he gave his sons. One duel left him with a severe head injury, and in old age he suffered delusions that he was back in the battles of his youth.
